kebab_example: aliyun linkedmall get-custom-service-url --biz-id LMALL202103150000 --biz-uid 2200778370000 --seller-id 2206801930000 --cuid 5512876 --nick 1232130001212 --use-anonymous-tb-account true --third-party-user-id 2200778370000 --account-type ANONY --api-version 2018-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCustomServiceUrl

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the business. This value is provided by Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh: 业务的唯一标识号，由阿里云提供
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en: The value must be the same as that of ThirdPartyUserId
parameters.name: biz_uid

parameters.help_en: The seller ID. If this parameter is not specified, the request is routed to the Xiaomi chatbot. If you specify a SellerId, the request is routed directly to the merchant's customer service
parameters.help_zh: 卖家ID，如果不传对接的是⼩蜜机器⼈；传sellerId后，可以直接对接商家客服
parameters.name: seller_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the end user on the customer side, used as the user identity. If this parameter is not specified, the user is treated as an anonymous user
parameters.help_zh: 客户⽅终端⽤户ID，⽤户的身份标识，不传时当做匿名⽤户
parameters.name: cuid

parameters.help_en: The nickname displayed on the Xiaomi interface. This parameter is optional. If not specified, a string of IDs is generated by default
parameters.help_zh: ⼩蜜界⾯上显示的⽤户昵称，可不传，默认⽣成⼀串ID
parameters.name: nick

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the user on the customer side
parameters.name: third_party_user_id
